.env.example Generator

Paste a .env file and get a safe .env.example with secret values stripped, comments kept.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your .env contents.
  2. Click Generate — values are stripped, keys and comments remain.
  3. Copy or download the result as .env.example.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What happens to the values?

Every KEY=value becomes KEY= (empty). Comments and blank lines are preserved; inline # comments stay attached.

Does it handle export prefixes?

Yes — `export KEY=value` lines keep their export prefix with an empty value.

What about quoted values?

Quoted values are emptied too, including multiline double-quoted values.

Is my .env uploaded anywhere?

No — it runs entirely in your browser, so secrets never leave your machine.
